description: The unchanged quantization test accepts an unavailable metric as satisfying its accuracy bound.
trigger: Metric computation raises a caught OutOfMemoryError, and subsequent reconstruction and packing succeed so test_quant_dequant receives proxy_err=-1.0.
expected_behavior: The proxy-error check should distinguish an unavailable metric from a measured error below its threshold.
actual_behavior: assert proxy_err < max_proxy_err_per_K[K] accepts -1.0 for every tested bitrate. Independent weight checks still run, so this does not establish that the entire test passes.

verification.description: Traced the new sentinel through the sole direct quantizer caller to both located consumers; conversion main handles it, but the test does not.
verification.limits: Reach is the inspected repository call sites, not external callers.

verification.description: Compared -1.0 with all eight transcribed test thresholds; all comparisons returned true.
verification.limits: No repository test or real OoM was executed.
